text:
maria: Quick sync on the AeroCompute + Redwood joint session next Wed. Goals: live demo switch, NFC/QR locker pickup for swag, and a small marketplace announcement at 10:10. Need owners for on-site fulfillment, SDK demo stability, and stream ingest.

liam: I can do SDK demo stability. Which SDK version are they shipping?

tara: AeroCompute asked us to ship v0.9.1 of the inference client for the demo. Oliver, can you confirm it works with our dedicated routing policy?

oliver: Quick check: v0.9.1 needs a routing flag --prefer-dedicated. I tested locally against staging with a small load and saw KV-cache warmup issues. I'll add a retry wrapper.

maria: Retry wrapper sounds good. Liam owns the smoke tests. Tara owns the marketplace announcement copy + embargo timing.

liam: For the live stream: are we going RTMP to CDN or using the venue encoder? RTMP gives us more control for captions injection.

ops-bot: Venue encoder recommended to reduce on-site complexity, but they can provide RTMP if needed.

maria: Let's do RTMP push to our relay so we can inject SRT captions and switch feeds for demo handoff. Oliver, can you stand up the relay?

oliver: I'll spin up a small relay on a m5 with Docker. Command:
```
docker run -d --name stream-relay -p 1935:1935 redwood/rtmp-relay:stable --ingest rtmp://venue/stream --out rtmp://cdn/redwood
```

liam: Good. I'll add a test that runs 5 concurrent sessions against the relay to ensure no dropouts.

maria: Swag plan: lockers (NFC tag + backup QR) so attendees can claim onsite. Fulfillment-bot: shipping cutoff for EU and NA?

fulfillment-bot: Shipping cutoff: NA ground 2026-03-28, EU courier 2026-03-24. Locker tags: pre-encoded NFC IDs ready by 2026-03-25.

tara: For locker flow, we'll pre-encode one-time claim tokens. The UX will allow on-device scan -> small form -> choose pickup or ship. We'll default to pickup to clear logistics.

maria: Show of hands: who owns the locker redemption endpoint and the marketplace announcement payload?

liam: I'll own locker redemption endpoint (simple POST -> verify token -> mark claimed).

tara: I'll own marketplace announcement copy and coordinate embargo with marketing. Draft will go to #marketing by EOD.

oliver: On demo fallback: plan B is to play a pre-recorded screen capture and switch audio to the in-person presenter. I will ensure the pre-recorded demo is in identical environment (same model version & flags).

maria: Nice. Rehearsals: Monday 20m full run, Wed tech check 15m before session. Everyone please join both. I'll invite AV + AeroCompute.

liam: Swag manifest CSV (working):
```
code,item,qty,region,type
RN-LKR-1001,sticker-pack,300,NA,locker
RN-LKR-1002,nano-bottle,100,EU,locker
RN-SHIP-2001,insulated-mug,40,NA,ship
```

maria: For customs, Tara, please add HS codes and a brief customs note per item. EU customs needs a CN23 for low-value gifts.

tara: On it. Also checking if AeroCompute wants co-branded packaging. If yes, lead time adds 7 days.

ops-bot: Venue confirmed locker vendor can mount 120 tags at Hall B site. Power and network available.

liam: Captioning: vendor must support SRT and provide a low-latency feed we can mux into the relay. I'll shortlist two and post costs.

maria: Quick decision rule: prefer lower translation error rate over marginal latency. We can accept +200ms.

oliver: I'll also prepare a health-check endpoint for the relay so SRE can monitor ingest, output, and caption stream. Health path: /healthz returns JSON.

maria: Minor privacy note: locker claim form must store minimal PII; fulfillment-bot, ensure the transportation vendor can accept hashed addresses for pickup.

fulfillment-bot: Confirmed. We can provision hashed tokens for pickup; shipping requires full addresses only for ship flow.

maria: Final assignments recap: Liam (SDK smoke & locker endpoint), Oliver (relay + fallback recording + health), Tara (marketplace copy + customs + packaging), Ops-bot & fulfillment-bot (locker vendor + shipping cutoff). Rehearsal invites will go out today.

oliver: I'll push the pre-recorded demo artifact to /shared/demos/aerocompute-v0.9.1.mp4 and version it.

liam: I'll add unit smoke test to CI and a quick manual run during Monday rehearsal.

maria: Thanks team. If anything blocks, add it to this thread or ping me directly. :rocket:
